review_candidates.title: Senior Data Scientist
review_candidates.description: ▪ Engagement Type: Short-term (8-12 weeks). ▪ Target Delivery: Rapid execution of specialized Machine Learning (ML) projects, with primary focus on high precision classification models to support business requirements. ▪ Role Purpose: Design, build, evaluate and handover a production-ready classification engine with an agile 8-12 week timeframe. The contractor will tackle specific business and data challenges, applying advanced ML (and potentially NLP) techniques while ensuring clear code documentation for seamless handover to the existing in-house team. ▪ Requirements (Qualification & Skills): - Years of Experience: 6+ years of hands-on experience in applied Data Science and ML, with a proven track record of end-to-end delivery on short deadline projects. - Education: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. - Portfolio: Must demonstrate a strong portfolio or case studies of successfully deployed text-matching, entity resolution, or complex classification systems in past roles/contracts. Must-Haves: - Classification and Predictive Analytics: Deep theoretical and practical command of supervised and unsupervised classification algorithms and predictive modeling pipelines. - Text Matching and NLP Expertise: Strong knowledge of string-similarity metrics, Fuzzy matching algorithms, TF-IDF vectorization, tokenization, and modern embedding models. - Core Technical Stack: Expert in SQL, and advanced Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, NLTK/Spacy, RapidFuzz, PyTorch, TensorFlow). - Problem Solving and Adaptability: A sharp, consultative mindset with an appetite to learn, and ability to effectively and efficiently navigate messy, unstandardized Arabic/English text datasets independently. - Handover and Operational Discipline: Writing clean, modular, well-documented code, structured notebooks, and reproducible pipelines that can easily be operationalized by the internal MLOps team post contract. Preferred: - Prior experience in Banking/Fintech domain and exposure to related projects.
